final: WITH risk_groups AS (SELECT si.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS group_avg FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref COLLATE BINARY = si.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY si.riskeval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM risk_groups) SELECT AVG(r.group_avg) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(r.group_avg - o.overall_avg) AS avg_excess FROM risk_groups AS r JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE r.group_avg > o.overall_avg
